author: Matt Walsh
description:
A century ago, left-wing radicals seized control of the Russian Empire and unleashed seven decades of ruthless terror, killing millions of people and inflicting untold human suffering. How did it happen? In this explosive episode of Real History, Matt Walsh traces Vladimir Lenin and the Bolsheviks' rise to power, and draws striking parallels to America today. He also breaks down the left's "rules for revolution," detailing exactly how radical, resentment-fueled movements seize power. Coming July 13.
